learning_objective: 🎯 Today we will learn how words join hands to make complete sense and find out the two magic parts of every sentence!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A sentence is a group of friendly words that hold hands to make complete sense. It tells us a full thought! Remember, a perfect sentence always starts with a capital letter and ends with a full stop.
Every sentence has a hero! The Subject is the person, place, animal, or thing we are talking about. It tells us WHO or WHAT is doing the action.
The Predicate is the action part of the sentence! It tells us what our hero (the Subject) is doing. It gives us all the fun information.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Build a Sentence Train!
fun_activity.instructions: Write names of your friends or family on red paper slips. These are your Subjects! Then, write fun actions on blue paper slips. These are your Predicates! Mix them up and match them to make silly sentences.

quick_recap: ⭐ A sentence is a group of words that gives a complete thought.
⭐ It begins with a big Capital letter and ends with a full stop.
⭐ The Subject is the hero of our sentence (Who or What).
⭐ The Predicate tells us what the hero is doing.
